title: 第9章 底层修仙者的烦恼第10章 住房问题
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
再次回到住处，龙涛恍如隔世，说真的...这次的任务他是没打算活着回来的，那支撑着他全程没尿裤子、甚至还能跟筑基狼王玩躲猫猫的稳定心态，全靠一个朴素而强大的信念撑着，老子是穿越的！
就算死了说不定还能穿回地球去呢。
要自己是个土生土长、把命看得比天还大的纯土着，估计出发前心态就崩了。
同时他也猜测这个系统多半不会只发一个坑爹任务，需要随时做好准备，而在这个修仙的世界，最重要的准备是什么......
实力！
这个世界，自身实力不够，连炮灰都不够格，练气五层实在太弱鸡了，不对，连“弱鸡”
这个词都配不上！
顶多算鸡饲料！
再弱的鸡被宰之前好歹还能叫两声呢，凡人和练气期的，那真是死了都发不出声音。
这个飞天遁地大佬遍地走的世界，自己就不指望有什么上桌的资格了，但起码得有呼吸权啊。
什么叫呼吸权，龙涛自己下了个定义，就是金丹级别放个威压，起码别直接昏过去的那种，那样的话连龙套都没资格当的。
不然万一哪天系统让他去个金丹元婴满地走的场面，人家大佬可能根本没想碾死他这只蚂蚁，只是无意识散发了些威压，就嘎嘣一声昏死过去，那还做个屁的任务。
所以首先...要筑基！
即使是那种靠大量丹药堆出来，只能用来装点门面的纯水货筑基，那也有个最大的功效，防晕！
面对金丹大佬的威压，再水的筑基也能清醒地喊出一句大佬饶命，哪怕当时已经五脏六腑移位，口喷三升鲜血，双膝跪地不起......
但即便是筑基，这个在前世很多小说里的炮灰境界，对龙涛来说都是目前可望不可及的，现实就是这么残酷。
穿越前，他也是被各路爽文忽悠瘸了的一员，觉得如果真有修仙世界，那练气应该相当于小学，筑基相当于中学，金丹相当于大学，以此往后类推。
然而来了这鬼地方他才明白，修真界的学历含金量高得吓人，通货膨胀？不存在的！
是严重通缩！
能够筑基就已经相当于进大学了，修炼这玩意儿，不是做题刷卷子，它烧的是真金白银的灵石、万里挑一的天赋、祖宗十八代积攒的人品！

大部分散修和普通弟子，终其一生也就止步于练气后期，不是他们能力和意志力不足，因为突破筑基需要的资源，一般人就已经负担不起了。
多少家族拼尽全族之力，也就能养出那么几个筑基，就这在凡俗世界已经足够护佑家族百年了，至于金丹...那特么需要祖坟冒青烟。
他记得看的很多小说里，随便一个城里的家族，都有十几个金丹坐镇，元婴族老喝茶下棋，化神老祖在后山闭关，现在想想也真是好笑。
不过目前别想这些太远的，先把练气六层突破是当务之急，这个爽文主角喝口水就能突破的境界，可是卡了他不少时间，之前咸鱼心态混日子，所以也不甚在意，现在可是真要拼命了，起码要拿出前世高三那股子拼劲了。
........
不过想要好好修炼，财侣法地四样当然都不能少。
财：
这个暂时是不用担心了，明天！
就明天！
那位人傻...人好钱多的南师弟，就要兑现谢礼了！
怎么说也是他用命做任务换来的，拿的可谓是心安理得。
而且身上还有着几株昨天在狼王巢穴里拔的草呢，能在九叶灵芝旁边蹭灵气的，总不至于是路边的狗尾巴草吧，加上那几个灵果核，也算是一笔小横财。
侣：
这个暂时别想了。
content_en:
Returning to his residence again, Long Tao felt like he was in another world. To be honest...he had no intention of coming back alive from this mission. The stable mentality that kept him from peeing his pants throughout the whole process and even playing hide-and-seek with the Foundation-Building Wolf King was all supported by a simple and powerful belief: I have traveled through time!
Even if you die, you might be able to travel back to Earth.
If I were a native who was born and raised and regarded my life as bigger than the sky, I would probably have lost my mentality before setting off.
At the same time, he also guessed that this system would probably not only send out one cheating mission, but would need to be prepared at any time, and in this world of cultivating immortals, what is the most important preparation...
Strength!
In this world, one's own strength is not enough, even cannon fodder is not qualified. The fifth level of Qi training is too weak. No, even "weak chicken"
It doesn’t even fit the word!
At most it’s considered chicken feed!
No matter how weak a chicken is, it can still crow twice before being slaughtered. For mortals and those in the Qi training stage, they can't even make a sound even if they are dead.
In this world where big bosses are flying and escaping, I don't expect to be qualified to serve on the table, but at least I have to have the right to breathe.
What is the right to breathe? Long Tao himself defined it as a golden elixir-level person who exerts pressure and at least does not faint directly. In that case, he is not even qualified to be a sidekick.
Otherwise, if one day the system asks him to go to a scene where Jindan Yuanying is everywhere, the boss may not even want to crush him as an ant. He may just unconsciously exude some coercion and pass out with a bang. What a shitty mission.
So first...build the foundation!
Even if it is a pure parallel import foundation building that relies on a large amount of pills and can only be used to decorate the appearance, it still has the greatest effect, preventing fainting!
Faced with the pressure of the golden elixir boss, no matter how inexperienced Zhuji is, he can still soberly shout "big boss, spare my life", even if his internal organs have been displaced, three liters of blood is spitting out of his mouth, and he can't stand on his knees...
But even foundation building, this cannon fodder realm in many novels in previous lives, is currently out of reach for Long Tao. The reality is so cruel.
Before traveling through time, he was one of those people who was deceived by various cool articles. He felt that if there really was a world of cultivating immortals, then Qi training should be equivalent to elementary school, foundation building to middle school, golden elixir to university, and so on.
However, after coming to this hellish place, he realized that the value of academic qualifications in the world of cultivation was frighteningly high. Inflation? Doesn't exist!
It's serious deflation!
Being able to build a foundation is equivalent to entering university. Cultivation is not about writing questions and papers. It is about burning real gold and silver spirit stones, one-in-a-million talents, and the character accumulated by eighteen generations of ancestors!
Most casual cultivators and ordinary disciples will end up in the late stage of Qi training throughout their lives. This is not because they lack ability and willpower, but because most people can no longer afford the resources needed to break through to foundation building.
No matter how many families try their best, they can only raise a few foundations. In the mortal world, this is enough to protect the family for hundreds of years. As for the golden elixir...it requires smoke from the ancestral graves.
He remembered that in many novels he read, any family in the city had more than a dozen golden elixirs in charge, the Nascent Soul clan always drank tea and played chess, and the ancestors of the Transformation Gods retreated in the back mountains. It was really funny to think about it now.
But don't think too far ahead. Breaking through the sixth level of Qi training is the top priority. The protagonist of this cool novel can break through with a sip of water, but he was stuck for a lot of time. Before, he had a salty mentality and was just dawdling, so he didn't care much about it. Now he really has to work hard, at least with the same hard work as a high school senior in his previous life.
........
But if you want to practice well, of course you must have all four things.
Wealth:
Don’t worry about this for now, tomorrow!
Just tomorrow!
That stupid...Junior Brother Nan who is kind and rich is about to cash in on his thank you gift!
After all, he earned it by doing tasks with his life, and what he got was peace of mind.
And bodyThere are still a few grasses that were plucked from the Wolf King's den yesterday. The ones that can rub the spiritual energy next to the Nine-leaf Ganoderma lucidum are definitely not the foxtail grass on the roadside. Plus those few spiritual fruit cores, it can be regarded as a small windfall.
Couple:
Don't think about this for now.
